intro: This page lists MBA colleges in Greater Noida where the recorded average package exceeds the recorded fee. It is a way to scan the best MBA colleges in Greater Noida where average package exceeds fees, not a promise for the next batch.
We currently show {{count}} published colleges on this filter. Read the programme name on each card, because some fees belong to a specialised PGDM or a diploma.
listLead: The first cards include BIMTECH, I Business Institute, GNIOT Institute of Management Studies and Noida International University. Some later cards show much lower recorded fees, which should be checked on the official notice.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. The median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, with averages ranging from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}.
Placement years in our file run from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}. All ten colleges are in Greater Noida, and CAT is the exam most often linked here.
Use the list of top MBA colleges in Greater Noida 2026 as a shortlist, then compare the official fee notice and placement report.
firstCollegesLead: BIMTECH is listed first, with a recorded PGDM in retail and aviation at ₹6.50 lakh and a 2024 average package of ₹16 lakh, plus a highest of ₹23 lakh. Confirm the official fee for the flagship PGDM if that is the programme you want.

I Business Institute shows a recorded PGDM Finance fee of ₹4.92 lakh and a 2024 average of ₹21 lakh, plus a highest of ₹50 lakh. Noida International University’s card shows a diploma in management at ₹60,000, which is not a two-year MBA fee.

compare.heading: How to compare the best MBA colleges in Greater Noida where average package exceeds fees
paragraphs: A specialised or diploma programme can make the fee look low, and a single high average can make the gap look large. Compare the official documents for the same course.
Before you apply, check these points:
bullets: Whether the card shows the flagship PGDM or MBA, or a retail, aviation or diploma programme.
Whether the fee is for one year or the full two-year programme.
The year of the placement report, which in our file runs from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
The entrance test (CAT is the most common link here) and the cut-off for your category.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in Greater Noida are on this value list?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published MBA colleges in Greater Noida currently meet this filter in our records, meaning the recorded average package is higher than the recorded fee for the programme on the card.

faqs.question: Does this mean the average salary will pay back the fee?
faqs.answer: No, the comparison uses historical package and fee figures in our file, and it does not include hostel or personal costs, so it is not a guarantee of a financial return.

faqs.question: Why does Noida International University show a ₹60,000 fee?
faqs.answer: The card in our records is a diploma in management, not a two-year MBA, so it should not be compared as if it were the flagship postgraduate fee.

faqs.question: What is a typical fee and average package here?
faqs.answer: The median recorded fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, with recorded averages ranging from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}.

faqs.question: Which exam do these colleges accept?
faqs.answer: CAT is the exam most often linked here, with some colleges also linked to ATMA or XAT. Confirm the current process on the official admission page.
